C x.mc-constructors EX RUN-009 PREFER ;; Prefer a normal constructor when initialization, validation, field naming or debugging is clearer that way. ;; = ;; none ;; Constructor technique (EXC-002).
C x.mc-feature-usage EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Collection expressions when the target type is clear; required when initialization is part of the construction contract (not a substitute for validation); avoid deeply nested patterns; field keyword for trivial backing fields. ;; = ;; none ;; Language-feature technique (EXC-002).
C run009.no-mechanical-modernization OL RUN-009 MUST_NOT ;; Do not replace existing collection initializers, substantial backing fields or traditional extension methods solely for newer syntax. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.mc-records EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Records for immutable DTOs, Value Objects and messages; identity/lifecycle entities remain classes; do not convert every class to a record. ;; = ;; none ;; Record guidance (EXC-002).
C run008.raw-sql-rules OL RUN-008,SEC-004 MUST ;; Raw SQL in raw string literals still follows the performance and security rules. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.mc-immutability EX RUN-009 PREFER ;; Prefer immutability when natural; do not force it where controlled mutation is simpler. ;; = ;; none ;; Immutability guidance (EXC-002).
C run008.spans OL RUN-008,RUN-001 DEFAULT ;; Span/stackalloc/pooling are performance tools introduced only when profiling or a clearly hot path justifies them; ordinary collections by default. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.mc-langversion-check EX RUN-009 MUST ;; Confirm the configured language version supports a feature before using it. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C dep008.langversion-stack OL DEP-008,DEP-002 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing LangVersion or the target framework is a stack decision, not a modernization step. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run009.modernization-task OL RUN-009,GOV-014,WF-005 MUST ;; When asked to modernize: preserve behaviour, keep focused, prefer readability, build and test, no unrelated architecture refactoring. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run009.avoid-list OL RUN-009,RUN-008 AVOID ;; Avoid newest syntax for its own sake, record struct merely to avoid allocations, Span<T> without a performance reason, deeply nested patterns and mass constructor conversion. ;; = ;; none ;;

70 NN ;; Heading.
72-75 MX [wf005.pc-verify,x.pc-fresh-db-check,wf019.explicit-production] ;; Building and testing is WF-005; confirming migrations apply to a fresh Development database before seeding is added; production migration as explicit deployment work is WF-019.

C wf001.pc-read-rules OL WF-001 MUST ;; Read persistence-technology.md and architecture.md first if they have not loaded. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst.assess-impact OL PST-008,PST-009,PST-010 MUST ;; Assess changed entities, relationships, constraints, indexes and columns, schema impact and impact on seeded entities before changing persistence. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.pc-mapping-location EX ARC-019 DEFAULT ;; Change IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> mappings in the adapter layer. ;; = ;; none ;; EF mapping technique not in the oracle.
C arc002.config-out-of-model-pc OL ARC-002 MUST ;; Keep persistence-specific configuration out of the core model where practical. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.pc-migration-project EX ARC-019 DEFAULT ;; Create migrations from the adapter-layer project with the composition-root project as startup project. ;; = ;; none ;; Migration command technique.
C pst010.review OL PST-010 MUST ;; Treat migrations as source code and review every generated migration before committing (destructive changes, column recreation, data migrations, indexes, FKs, delete behaviour). ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst009.no-casual-alter OL PST-009 MUST_NOT ;; Do not casually alter existing migrations; regenerate/edit an uncommitted migration only when that matches the normal workflow. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst008.seeder-cochange OL PST-008 MUST ;; Whenever Domain/persistence changes affect seeded entities update DbSeeder in the same change; review/update it with migrations affecting the seeded graph. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst006.no-patch-rows OL PST-006,PST-008 MUST ;; Migrating an existing development database does not require patching seeded rows; recreating at any revision yields valid representative data. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst009.schema-settings OL PST-009 MUST ;; For schema-affecting CUSTOM_SETTINGS changes update the mapping, create the migration per step 3, verify seeding validity, update provider-sensitive tests when relevant. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf005.pc-verify OL WF-005 MUST ;; Build affected projects and run persistence/integration tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.pc-fresh-db-check EX PST-005,WF-006 MUST ;; Confirm the migration applies to a freshly created Development database before seeding. ;; = ;; none ;; Specific verification step not in the oracle.
C wf019.explicit-production OL WF-019 MUST ;; Production migration remains explicit deployment work. ;; = ;; none ;;

C arc005.ddd-dirs-approved OL ARC-005,ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Create Domain directories only when needed; ValueObjects/DomainServices/Events/Exceptions only when justified by an approved design; not because the Domain has business rules. ;; = ;; Approved design. ;;
C arc027.real-code-dirs OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Create only directories that contain real code. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.bl-folder-layout EX ARC-027,DEP-024 DEFAULT ;; Scaffold backend folders by role: Application Abstractions/Persistence, Abstractions/ExternalServices, Services, DTOs, Validation, DependencyInjection.cs; Infrastructure Persistence/{Configurations,Repositories,Migrations,Seeding}, Services, DependencyInjection.cs. ;; = ;; Only when needed. ;; Directory layout convention (EXC-004).
C arc014.no-tech-types-contracts OL ARC-014,ARC-008 MUST_NOT ;; Persistence contracts in Application contain no persistence-technology types. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.external-when-needed OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Do not create Abstractions/ExternalServices before such dependencies exist. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc009.no-mediator-structures OL ARC-009 MUST_NOT ;; No handler/CQRS/mediator structures in Application Services. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.dto-not-dump OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; DTOs are Application models when useful, not a dumping ground. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc023.app-di OL ARC-023,ARC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Application DependencyInjection.cs registers Application-owned services/validation, never concrete Infrastructure implementations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.bl-type-roles EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Make supporting-type roles clear via established suffixes (Service, Dto, Request/Response, Result/Outcome, Validator, Rules/Policy, Factory, Mapper, Adapter); avoid ambiguous names; subdirectories only when a flat directory gets hard to navigate. ;; = ;; none ;; Naming heuristics (EXC-004).
C arc027.no-generic-buckets OL ARC-027 AVOID ;; Avoid generic Models/Helpers/Common/Utils buckets when a specific responsibility can be named. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc015.generic-base-infra OL ARC-015 ALLOWED ;; An Infrastructure-only generic repository base is allowed when it removes real duplication. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc023.infra-di OL ARC-023 DEFAULT ;; Infrastructure DependencyInjection.cs registers persistence session/provider, repositories, IUnitOfWork, adapters, HttpClient integrations, resilience handlers when used. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.optional-dirs OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Create optional Api directories only when needed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc010.no-minimal-api OL ARC-010,DEP-008 MUST_NOT ;; Controllers are the HTTP endpoint mechanism; do not create Minimal API endpoint groups unless explicitly requested. ;; = ;; Explicit request. ;;
C arc029.contracts-when-called OL ARC-029 DEFAULT ;; Contracts hold transport-specific request/response contracts when architecture.md § Layer Placement calls for them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.middleware-exists OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Middleware folder only when custom middleware exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.bl-program-extensions EX ARC-012 MUST_NOT ;; Extensions hold cohesive API/composition methods; do not move arbitrary code out of Program.cs solely to shorten it. ;; = ;; none ;; Program.cs organisation rule not in the oracle.
C arc012.program-root OL ARC-012 DEFAULT ;; Program.cs is the composition root (AddApplication, AddInfrastructure). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.useful-test-projects OL ARC-027,DEP-013 MUST_NOT ;; Create only useful test projects; Domain.Tests/Infrastructure.Tests only for non-trivial behaviour benefiting from a dedicated assembly. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.ref-graph OL ARC-001 MUST ;; Project reference graph: Domain none; Application→Domain; Infrastructure→Application, Domain; Api→Application, Infrastructure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.reconsider OL ARC-001 MUST ;; If a feature seems to require an outward reference (e.g. Application→Infrastructure) reconsider the abstraction boundary instead. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc028.test-ref-graph OL ARC-028 MUST ;; Test references: Domain.Tests→Domain; Application.Tests→Application (+Domain as needed); IntegrationTests→Api; Infrastructure.Tests→Infrastructure with narrower references as required. ;; = ;; none ;;

C arc027.target-not-requirement OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; The target structure is not a requirement to create every optional directory or project immediately. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep022.slnx-scaffold OL DEP-022 DEFAULT ;; Use the .slnx solution format (legacy .sln exception per the technology stack). ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep024.backend-all OL DEP-024,DEP-013 DEFAULT ;; All backend .NET projects, including test projects, live under backend/. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep024.frontend-outside OL DEP-024,DEP-007 DEFAULT ;; The frontend workspace lives outside the .NET tree under frontend/ProjectName.Web/ and owns package.json, package-lock.json, framework configuration and sources. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep014.no-obsolete-structure OL DEP-014 MUST_NOT ;; Do not impose an obsolete directory structure when the current framework CLI generates a different supported one. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep013.tests-beside-ref OL DEP-013,DEP-024 DEFAULT ;; Backend tests sit beside the production projects under backend/. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.frontend-test-placement EX DEP-024 DEFAULT ;; Frontend unit/component tests inside the workspace, typically colocated; E2E tests, when introduced, e.g. under frontend/ProjectName.Web/e2e/. ;; = ;; none ;; Frontend test placement convention not in the oracle.
C dep024.no-frontend-tests-in-backend OL DEP-024 MUST_NOT ;; Do not place frontend tests under backend/. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep024.docs-when-exist OL DEP-024,ARC-027 MUST ;; Use docs/ for maintained documentation; create architecture/, decisions/, api/ only when such documentation exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep023.shared-only OL DEP-023 DEFAULT ;; Directory.Build.props holds shared settings only; remove properties dotnet new duplicates in project files. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep006.cpm-one-place OL DEP-006 MUST ;; Directory.Packages.props holds NuGet CPM versions in one place. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.tooling-over-instructions EX RUN-009 PREFER ;; Keep deterministic formatting/code-style in .editorconfig; prefer enforceable tooling over restating mechanical formatting rules in instructions. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-design preference (repo/meta).
C x.gitignore EX SEC-001 DEFAULT ;; Ignore generated/local artifacts (bin, obj, .vs, node_modules, dist, TestResults, coverage, local secret/config overrides). ;; = ;; Where applicable. ;; Ignore-file convention not in the oracle.
C dep026.dont-ignore-dev-contract OL DEP-026 MUST_NOT ;; Do not ignore files intentionally part of the Development configuration contract. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep018.optional-infra OL DEP-018,GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Docker files, deployment manifests, Kubernetes, cloud/messaging infrastructure and extra services stay out until a concrete requirement exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
